scales.F: Frequency (Never → Always), labels also show the agreement wording
scales.A: Agreement (Absolutely disagree → Absolutely agree), labels also show the frequency wording
scales.FR: Frequency, REVERSED: negative statement (Q5). "Never" is stored as 5
scales.AR: Agreement, REVERSED: negative statement (Q45). "Absolutely disagree" is stored as 5
scales.C: Change over the last year (Q50). 5 options, no "Don't know"; 1 = significantly deteriorated

model.answerValues: Stored raw 1–5. 5 is ALWAYS the most positive answer. 1 = "Don't know" (except Q50, where 1 = significantly deteriorated).

intro.title: {company} wants to hear from you
intro.body: {company} is running an engagement survey together with the Adizes Institute. You will answer {n} questions about your daily work and the organization.
bullets: The survey is anonymous: answers are combined, and {company} never sees anyone’s individual answers.
For each question, say how important it is to you. Mark up to 15 as “Most important” (at least one).
You can add a comment to any question. Comments are shared word for word without your name, so avoid details that identify you.
It takes about 10–15 minutes. You can pause and continue later with the same link.
intro.note: Answer for how things actually are today. If you have no basis to answer, choose “Don’t know”.

review.title: Review your answers
review.needMost: Mark at least {min} question as “Most important” before sending (open any question to change it).
review.missingHelp: Click any question to answer or change it.
review.warn: Click any question to change your answer, its importance or your comment. Once sent, your answers can’t be changed.
review.hint: You can also send from the bottom of the list.

pdf.title: Engagement Survey
pdf.subtitle: Report
pdf.anon: The survey is anonymous. Results are only shown in aggregate, and groups with fewer than 5 answers are never shown on their own.
pdf.levelsHelp: Each participant is classified from all their answers and from the questions they marked as most important.
pdf.byAreaHelp: Only areas with 5 or more answers are shown. Smaller areas are combined into “Other areas” when together they reach 5.
pdf.hidden: {n} answers from areas with fewer than 5 people are counted only in the company total.
pdf.noAreas: No area has 5 or more answers yet, so results by area are not shown.
pdf.factorsHelp: Score of each factor from the answers (“Don’t know” not counted), with the same method as the Adizes diagnostic matrix. 75% or more is healthy; under 50% is an anomaly.
pdf.topHelp: The questions most often marked as “Most important”, and how they were answered.
pdf.distHelp: Distribution of answers (%) and, in red on the right, the share of respondents who marked each question as most important.
pdf.q50: Green is always the most positive answer: for the negative statements 5 and 45 that is “Never” / “Absolutely disagree”. Question 50 uses its own scale (significantly improved → significantly deteriorated).
pdf.commentsHelp: Written by participants, anonymous and word for word.

intro.title: {company} quiere escucharte
intro.body: {company} está realizando una encuesta de compromiso junto con el Instituto Adizes. Responderás {n} preguntas sobre tu trabajo diario y la organización.
bullets: La encuesta es anónima: las respuestas se combinan y {company} nunca ve las respuestas individuales.
En cada pregunta indica qué tan importante es para ti. Marca hasta 15 como “Lo más importante” (al menos una).
Puedes dejar un comentario en cualquier pregunta. Los comentarios se comparten tal cual, sin tu nombre; evita detalles que te identifiquen.
Toma de 10 a 15 minutos. Puedes pausar y continuar después con el mismo enlace.
intro.note: Responde según cómo son las cosas hoy. Si no tienes elementos para responder, elige “No sé”.

review.hint: También puedes enviarlas al final de la lista.

pdf.anon: La encuesta es anónima. Los resultados solo se muestran en conjunto y los grupos con menos de 5 respuestas nunca se muestran por separado.
toc: Lo más importante para los colaboradores
pdf.levelsHelp: Cada participante se clasifica con todas sus respuestas y con las preguntas que marcó como lo más importante.
pdf.byAreaHelp: Solo se muestran las áreas con 5 o más respuestas. Las áreas más pequeñas se combinan en “Otras áreas” cuando juntas suman 5.
pdf.hidden: {n} respuestas de áreas con menos de 5 personas se cuentan solo en el total de la empresa.

pdf.distHelp: Distribución de respuestas (%) y, en rojo a la derecha, el porcentaje de participantes que marcaron cada pregunta como lo más importante.
